[[File:EchoStation3-T-A.jpg|thumb|right|300px|An Echo Station just outside Hoth's Echo Base]]
'''Echo Stations''' were a series of small scouting outposts on the icy [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and were used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to keep an eye out for native dangers such as the [[Wampa/Legends|Wampa]] and for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] activity. They supplemented the defensive regime of the Rebel Alliance's main base on Hoth, [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].<ref name="V">{{Film|V}}</ref> Echo Stations were built around a wide area of the planet's surface to monitor [[Meteorite/Legends|meteor activity]] and to detect any potential [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial vessels]].<ref name="Illustrated">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>
